messages.subject: URL parameters in Shiny
parts:
Hey guys,

I'm not overly experienced with HTML/Javascript, but I have written a lot of Shiny apps and I'm a fairly experienced R user. My problem is this: I want to be able to send a link to someone, and have that link contain the correct URL parameters for the inputs as I have entered them on the app. I found a solution here: https://gist.github.com/alexbbrown/6e77383b48a044191771

This worked for a little while, but it seems to have broken with newer version of Shiny. I am wondering if anyone can help with this, or if there has been new functionality to help with this added to Shiny? Thanks for any help
